[Intro]
[G]
[D]I

[Verse 1]
[G]went to the crossroad,
fell down on my knees
I
[C]went to the crossroad,
fell down on my knees
[G]
Asked the Lord above,
[D]"Have mercy,
[C]save poor Bob if you please"
[G]
Mmmm,

[Verse 2]
[G]standin' at the crossroad,
I tried to flag a ride
Standin' at the cross-
[C]road,
I tried to flag a ride
[G]
Ain't nobody seem
[D]to know me, [C]everybody pass me by
[G]
Mmmm,

[Verse 3]
[G]the sun goin' down boy,
dark goin' catch me here
Ooooh ooh
[C]eeee,
boy dark goin' catch me here
[G]
I haven't got no
[D]lovin' sweet woman that
[C]love and feel my care
[G]
You can run,

[Verse 4]
[G]you can run,
tell my friend boy Willie Brown
You can
[C]run,
tell my friend boy Willie Brown
[G]
Lord that I'm standing at
[D]the crossroad, babe I [C]believe I'm sinkin' down
[G]
title: Crossroad Blues
tuning: D G D G B D
